system: You play Crafter from the game screen. Think about the best course of action step by step, then finish with one line: ACTION: <action>
label: Vision PPO, 1.23M env steps

provenance.model: Random-init Qwen3-VL screen student (text width 256, 6 layers; vision 4 layers), supervised on Qwen Next reasoning, then PPO
provenance.training: Sample Factory PPO on native CUDA Crafter worlds, length-normalized (GSPO) response ratio, -0.1 penalty for answers without an action
provenance.checkpoint: best checkpoint at 4,800 learner steps, 1,228,800 env steps (100-episode rolling mean 12.69 when selected; selection makes this optimistic)
provenance.input: the 256x256 game screen and the accomplished-achievements line only; no text observation, no history
provenance.export: zerohero/crafter_student_wasm.py: vision and KV-cache decoder ONNX graphs, checked against Transformers before writing
